title: EvoLink-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Interdependent Task Streams
description: To address this gap, we introduce EvoLink-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate self-evolving agents in long-horizon, interdependent task streams. Figure 1 illustrates its overall design, including two evolution levels, a persistent task environment, and a unified evaluation protocol.
author: XLCYun

images.caption: Overview of EvoLink-Bench: L1 factual and L2 capability evolution in interdependent task streams. Evaluation separates retries from persistent updates and measures task scores, recovery, state changes, and reuse.
